steps.name: Step 1 — [NEW] Navigate to the pipeline (Artifact toolkit already attached + wired into the LLM node via the fixture's API-driven setup); verify the attached-toolkit card renders
Step 2 — [NEW] Verify the LLM node's Toolkits select shows the attached toolkit as a selected chip (wired via tool_names at creation)
Step 3 — Turn on the "Attachments" MODULES switch; attach button flips disabled -> enabled instantly, no Save required
Step 4 — Locate the "Attach Files (10 left)" button; visible, enabled, correct tooltip text
Step 5 — Click the attach button; native file chooser opens
Step 6 — Select the .txt file; it appears as an attachment chip with the exact filename, and the tooltip decrements to '9 left'
Step 7 — Send a message that requires resolving the attachment's actual content (NOT a generic summarize request); message bubble shows text+chip, composer's chip count resets to 0

Step 8 — [STRENGTHENED] Verify the pipeline actually resolves the attachment's content: no execution error, AND the response contains the correct fact from the file's actual content (not merely the filename or a generic acknowledgment)
Step 9 — No console errors were introduced at any step
